items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He could have been Joe Wrightman, Zuddy, we never did get straight on that.

ctx.x: He could have been Joe Wrightman, Zuddy, we never did get straight on that. But he was terrific.

But I think that was the first mixed band I ever played with because Charlie was going to play this benefit for Bob Russell. He was a Negro producer, you know, and they were giving a big thing at the Booker Washington Theatre. That was right in the section, you know. And so Charlie said to me, said I think I'll ask these old boys, say go up and play this benefit with us, see because we were playing at West Lake, see, alternating like, you know, two
